mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an easing monetary policy stance, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions and impending economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous deterioration in labor market conditions (UNRATE rising) and industrial output (INDPRO falling) indicates a dual stress scenario that increases recession risk, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both UNRATE rises >0.3pp and INDPRO falls >0.5% over 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annualized), a rise in the federal funds rate compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past three months indicates robust consumer demand and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST has increased over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales below 350,000 million dollars signals weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS < 350000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of supply constraint (INDPRO < 100), a further decline in industrial production indicates worsening supply conditions, increasing inflationary pressures and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100 and INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past three months indicates weakening economic activity and reduced corporate output, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO has declined over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
